Settings

Portfolio watermark

Shows public/images/watermark.png on the portfolio images you mark with “Watermark”. Your original images are never changed.

Two switches must both be on: (1) “Enable watermark” below, and (2) the “Watermark” tick on each project cover / screenshot — or use Apply to all images under this form to tick everything at once.

Apply to all images

Ticks (or un-ticks) “Watermark” on every project cover and screenshot in one go. You can still change single images later in Portfolio → Edit.
